note: Intake classification. The value is not in collecting answers — it is that each answer is known in advance to trigger specific downstream work, with a named owner. A question earns its place here only if the answer changes what somebody has to do. Anything that does not is a field on a form, not an intake question.

routing.note: Any single exception driver routes the client off the template path. Weight is a secondary signal: enough individually-ordinary answers still add up to a mandate nobody should run on the standard track.
